user.title: Connect to Murdock
user.description: Address of the Murdock proxy. The add-on serves it on port 8099 — publish that port under the add-on's Network options first. The API token is shown in Murdock's Web UI under Settings → Home Assistant → API access.

satellite.title: Map a satellite
satellite.description: Assign a Murdock satellite ID to its assist_satellite entity. The mapping is explicit on purpose — a wrong mapping means right speaker, wrong room.

data.mqtt_topic_prefix: Murdock MQTT topic prefix (blank = REST event bus only)

reauth_confirm.title: Re-enter the API token
reauth_confirm.description: Murdock at {url} refused the stored token. Enter the token from Murdock's Web UI (Settings → Home Assistant → API access).
